Coloring book · Animal 22

Master of Disguise

Help the octopus cross the reef: hunt, solve a puzzle, hide from the moray eel, escape from the seal and reach its cave.

WalkHold GO (or your finger on the water). BACK to go back. Swipe up or down to go far or near.
HuntGet close to a crab or shrimp and tap GRAB: an arm catches it with its suckers.
Defend yourselfCAMOUFLAGE to hide, INK to confuse and JET to shoot away.
Screen:
The baby octopuses hatched!
★★★

Very smartIt opens jars, solves puzzles and learns by watching. Each arm has its own brain cells.
Master of disguiseIt changes color and texture in less than a second to hide.
Three heartsIt has three hearts, blue blood and no bones: it squeezes through tiny holes.

If you see an octopus in the sea, watch it from far away and never take it out of the water: it's its home!

Real sound of a New Zealand fur seal (New Zealand Department of Conservation, Wikimedia Commons, CC BY 4.0). The octopus, the moray eel and the water use soft synthesized sounds: octopuses make no noise.
